evidence.field: oracle-script glyph identity, source attribution, and rights
evidence.text: The Commons description identifies 方-oracle.svg as a modern vector depiction of 方 in oracle-script style. It attributes the depicted form to the j20269 image in hanziyuan.net’s 方 data and marks the vector representation public domain. It is a digital redraw, not an artifact photograph.
evidence.title: File:方-oracle.svg

evidence.field: Shuowen seal-style glyph identity, source attribution, and rights
evidence.text: The Commons description identifies 方-seal.svg as a modern vector depiction of 方 in Shuowen seal-script style. Its file history cites hanziyuan.net image s06196. The vector representation is marked public domain; it is not an artifact photograph.
evidence.title: File:方-seal.svg

evidence.text: Following the source page’s original-file links returned these exact URLs: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/c/ca/%E6%96%B9-oracle.svg and https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/%E6%96%B9-seal.svg. The web tool could not fetch the SVG content because its content type was unsupported; the page-derived links were nevertheless exposed in the failed fetch responses.
evidence.kind: access failure with resolved source-page links
evidence.title: File:方-oracle.svg

search_audit.query: Wikimedia Commons 方-oracle.svg 方 seal.svg historical character
search_audit.outcome: Search results identified Commons pages for the oracle-style and seal-style 方 SVG files. Both pages were opened and inspected for description, source attribution, and rights.
Inspected the Commons file page. It identifies a modern vector redraw in oracle-script style, attributes it to hanziyuan.net item j20269, and states the SVG representation is public domain.

Inspected the Commons file page. It identifies a modern vector redraw in Shuowen seal-script style, cites hanziyuan.net item s06196 in the file history, and states the SVG representation is public domain.

search_audit.query: Original-file links on the two inspected Wikimedia Commons pages
search_audit.outcome: Followed the original-file links exposed by each Commons page. Web retrieval failed for both with unsupported image/svg+xml content type, but the exact direct URLs were returned in the failure responses.

gaps: The web tool could not retrieve or render either SVG due to unsupported image/svg+xml content type. The file descriptions and rights were inspected, but the actual image pixels were not visually inspected in this research stage.

items.period: Shang oracle-script style; the Commons file does not assign a more precise date to this specific rendered glyph.
items.tradition: Oracle-bone script style; modern vector redraw sourced to hanziyuan.net item j20269.
items.caption: A modern redraw of 方 in an oracle-script style, included as an early-form candidate. The interpretation of the graph’s original referent remains disputed.
items.alt: Modern vector rendering of the character 方 in an oracle-script style.
items.selection_reason: Provides an early graphic comparison relevant to the disputed Shang form history, with a source attribution and explicit public-domain rights statement on the file page.
items.rights: Public domain as a modern SVG representation, according to the Commons file page; this is a redraw, not an ancient artifact image.

items.period: Shuowen seal-script style; a Han-era lexicographic script tradition, represented here by a modern vector redraw.
items.tradition: Shuowen seal script style; modern vector redraw sourced to hanziyuan.net item s06196.
items.caption: A modern redraw of 方 in the Shuowen seal-script style, showing the later traditional form recorded by the dictionary tradition.
items.alt: Modern vector rendering of 方 in Shuowen seal-script style.
items.selection_reason: Pairs an early-style form candidate with the later seal-script tradition represented by the historical Shuowen account; the file page provides provenance and public-domain rights information.
items.rights: Public domain as a modern SVG representation, according to the Commons file page; this is a redraw, not an ancient artifact image.

limitations.text: Both direct SVG requests failed in the web tool because it does not accept the image/svg+xml content type. Exact URLs were resolved from the source-page original-file links, but glyph pixels were not visually inspected.
